verdicts.description: Exactly one entry per item in answers_to_review, using its question's question_key, with no duplicates and no invented keys.

question_key.description: Copy the reviewed question's question_key exactly.

verdict.description: ACCEPT: the answer may be sent as it is. REVISE: the answering AI should answer it again; say why in reason and what you want in correction. CANNOT_ANSWER: nothing in the packet can answer this question truthfully, or a revision cannot fix it.

reason.description: One or two sentences: what you checked and why this verdict. For REVISE, the exact problem.

correction.description: For REVISE, the change you want (e.g. which recorded fact to use, which of the employer's choices fits, a shorter text). null otherwise.

untrue_fact.description: true only when your objection is that the answer states a fact about the owner that the packet does not support or contradicts (the one hard line); false for ACCEPT and for every other objection.
